name: ws-p4-nano-wifi6-db
title: Waveshare ESP32-P4-NANO-WIFI6-DB
notes: ESP32-P4NRW32 (32 MB PSRAM), 16 MB flash (GD25Q128); the dual-band ESP32-C5 companion isn't used. Same Ethernet as the P4-NANO: IP101GRI with IDF's P4 defaults (MDC 31, MDIO 52, REF_CLK in on GPIO50), reset GPIO51, address 1. Pins: Waveshare docs page and schematic, Waveshare ethernetbasic example. microSD on SDMMC slot 0 (CLK 43, CMD 44, D0-D3 39-42) on LDO channel 4; supply switch on GPIO45 on by default. PoE module header (module in some kits). Power LED only.
